description: Create a Snapchat custom audience. sourceType FIRST_PARTY: a customer list, EMPTY until update_snapchat_ads_audience_users adds people (retention defaults to lifetime). LOOKALIKE: people like a customer-list seed — seedSegmentId + countries, lookalikeType BALANCE (default) / SIMILARITY / REACH, retention max 180. PIXEL: people who fired Snap Pixel events — pixelId + events (e.g. PURCHASE, ADD_CART) + retentionInDays up to 395. ENGAGEMENT is read-only on Snapchat and refused. An audience spends nothing; it is read back from Snapchat. Free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

events.description: PIXEL: the events that put someone in it, e.g. ["PURCHASE","START_CHECKOUT"]

lookalikeType.description: BALANCE (default), SIMILARITY or REACH; LOOKALIKE audiences only

name.description: audience name in Snapchat Ads Manager

retentionInDays.description: FIRST_PARTY default lifetime (9999); LOOKALIKE max 180 (default 180); PIXEL required, max 395

seedSegmentId.description: LOOKALIKE: the customer-list audience to model

name: create_snapchat_ads_audience
title: Create a Snapchat audience
